text:
Mei: quick callout 1/ We see a 6% BLEU-style drop on newmodel-qbringup vs baseline when scoring promptbank+rag-synth. Pattern looks concentrated on prompts with inline tables and CSV blobs.

Jorge: can you drop the eval command and sample ids? I'll spin up local reproduction.

Mei: repro line:
```
rwt/eval --model newmodel-qbringup --dataset promptbank/holdout-2022 --metrics bleu,exact_match --batch 128 --tokenizer token-aligner-v1
```
Summary: bleu: 0.412 (baseline fp32 0.441); exact_match 0.62 -> 0.67

Priya: tagging curation + label ops. Could be prompt normalization differences after the recent anchor merge. We did fuzzyhash threshold 0.78 change last Friday.

Sam: infra-bot says no runtime driver changes. infra-bot: No kernel updates in the window; autoscale maintenance at 03:12 UTC.

Jorge: initial per-example diffs show failures correlate with inline separators (commas/pipe) and long token spans. Maybe tokenizer split behavior changed.

Mei: examples with big deltas: id: T-998 delta_bleu -0.28 tokens 210 (csv), id: T-777 delta_bleu -0.19 tokens 48 (table), id: T-333 delta_bleu -0.14 tokens 16

labeler-bot: Labelers on duty: 4. Current rapid queue: 180. Estimated triage time for 100 items: ~10h.

Priya: Proposed plan:
1) run eval with tokenizer=token-aligner-v0 (previous),
2) run newmodel with quantization profile qint8-debug to see if quantization exacerbates splits,
3) generate top-200 failing prompts and run a dedupe+orphan-anchor check (orphan anchors = anchors without provenance).

Mei: agree. Also surface a short rubric for labelers: check tokenization boundaries, csv/table parsing, hallucinated header rows, deid leakage.

Jorge: starting variant runs now; also will add `--preserve-newlines` flag to see impact.

infra-bot: Job submitted: eval-76234. Logs: https://ci.internal/evals/76234

Priya: I'll create workspace rapid-curation-orphan for labelers and upload the failing set. Include a dedupe run with `fuzzy-levenshtein --threshold 0.75`.

Mei: If dedupe finds many near-duplicates we might be misattributing regression to noisy anchors. Good call.

Jorge: variant results: token-aligner-v0 restores a lot of the gap: bleu 0.435; qint8-debug still shows slight degradation vs fp32 but smaller. `--preserve-newlines` helps on table cases.

labeler-bot: Update: 4 labelers processed 100/200. Flags so far: 22 tokenization, 14 formatting, 3 deid, 8 duplicate (merge candidate), rest model-edge.

Priya: dedupe pass finds 27 near-duplicates among top-200; several anchors lacked provenance (orphan anchors). I'm marking those for micro-golden refresh.

Mei: action items:
- Priya to run micro-golden refresh: create goldlet of flagged and orphan anchors (name: mg-newmodel-tokenfix-2022)
- Jorge to add test that enforces tokenizer parity between qbringup and baseline in CI
- Sam to hold the canary for newmodel-qbringup until we validate micro-gold and labels

Sam: Reserving one dev-gpu node for a 4h micro-golden rescore; starting in 10m.

Jorge: PR prepared to pin tokenizer to token-aligner-v0 for the qbringup experiments + added a per-prompt regression alert that posts to #eng-alerts.

Mei: timeline? Need signoff before tomorrow deploy window.

Jorge: initial micro-golden run estimate: 2.5h. Labeler final sweep ~6h. We can unblock after both.

labeler-bot: Final update: all 200 processed. Totals: 34 tokenization, 20 formatting/csv issues, 5 deid, 22 dupes (moved to merge queue), 119 model-candidate (likely true model error).

Priya: Based on labels: roughly 30% of failures attributable to tokenization/formatting; 11% due to dupes/orphans. Remainder are real model regressions on long spans that need dev attention.

Mei: decision: block rollout. Merge tokenizer parity PR and land micro-golden refresh. After rescore, we'll re-eval and produce a per-prompt regression dashboard.

Jorge: will also run a small quant sweep (qint8-debug -> qint8-opt) to see if any kernel-level quant profile reduces long-span noise.

Sam: Noted. Ill schedule a short postmortem doc with timeline + labeler verdicts and remediation steps. Link when ready.

Mei: thanks team. Good found by the labelers on orphan anchors. We'll re-open thread once rescore + quant sweep finish. :sparkles:
